The '''Crakull system'''<ref name="EAOC" /> was a small<ref name="ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Crakull]], [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Croke]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="NEGtC" /> Around [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Crakull-[[Reproduction/Legends|born]] Croke<ref name="NEGtC" /> [[Rokur Gepta]] infiltrated the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] sect based on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Tund/Legends|Tund]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had visited the Crakull system once by<ref name="ThonBoka" /> [[2 BBY/Legends|2.5 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'' between [[3 BBY/Legends|3]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2.5 BBY]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] visit to the Crakull [[Star system/Legends|system]], as mentioned in the novel, must therefore have taken place by 2.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> coming to regard the place as nasty.<ref name="ThonBoka" /> At some point, the Croke [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] planets in the<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> Unknown Regions<ref name="EAOC Explume Minor">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Explume Minor system/Legends|Explume Minor system]]</ref> area known as the [[Croke Reach]], including the world [[Explume Minor]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star/Legends|star]] system that was home to the Croke was first indirectly mentioned in the [[1983]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'', the final volume in [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy, which was written by [[L. Neil Smith]].<ref name="ThonBoka" /> The [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' specified that the Croke were native to the planet Crakull.<ref name="NEGtC" />

In [[2009]], the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' introduced the Crakull system, placing it within grid square G-10.<ref name="TEA" /> ''Atlas'' co-author [[Jason Fry]] has stated that planets not assigned a star system in a published source can be assumed to be located in the system of the same name.<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref>
